text:
We will possess beds heaped with aromas

And, like tombs, very deep divans,

And strange flowers on the consoles,

Our own, that burst in warmer skies.


Stirring final ardors to the limit,

Both hearts will be two torches

Whose indistinct lights will be reflected

In our two souls, one day twin.


And, at last, on a rose and mystic blue evening,

We will exchange a single lightning flash

Like a sob heavy with farewells.


And later, an Angel, half-opening doors,

Will come to revive, faithful and joyful,

The clouded mirrors and the dead flames.

translation.title: The Death of Lovers
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the lovers' death chamber as sensual, funereal, and finally revived by the angel.
